scripture.verse: They limited the Holy One of Israel
And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly, triumphing over them in it.
Having a desire to depart and to be with Christ, which is far better.
Who can tell if God will turn and repent, and turn away from his fierce anger, that we perish not?
Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty.

sermons.title: Sermon 277 | The Blood of the Everlasting Covenant

scripture.verse: The blood of the everlasting covenant.
And grieve not the Holy Spirit of God, whereby ye are sealed unto the day of redemption.
And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that heareth say, Come. And let him that is athirst come. And whosoever will, let him take the water of life freely.
The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.
